svg.title: Changing the middle changes the answer
svg.desc: Educational reconstruction of an Anthropic 2025 case in Claude 3.5 Haiku. The model completes a prompt asking for the capital of the state containing Dallas with Austin. Researchers suppress Texas-related features found with a cross-layer transcoder and activate California-related features identified from an Oakland prompt. Keeping the Dallas input, they report a Sacramento output. Feature groups are not single neurons. A Dallas-to-Austin shortcut also coexists. Arrows summarize reported relationships, not actual neurons, weights or complete wiring.
